# fused-open-core

A local repository for code shared by Fused Engine and Threadify Engine. This repository has not been pushed or published.

The OAuth authorization server core is in [`oauthserver/`](oauthserver/README.md). Each Engine supplies its own identity, scopes, storage, HTTP integration, and resource authorization.

The current license is copied from Fused Engine. A public open-source license has not yet been selected or granted for this repository.
